t: Allthemodium Ore spawns in the Deep Dark biome in cave walls and ceilings, you can also find it as a common spawn very high in the Mountains above 170Y, It can also be found everywhere in the mining dimension between Y -59 and Y 20. also Deepslate layer caves of the Other Dimension
ATM矿石会生成在深暗之域生物群系的洞穴墙壁和天花板上；你也可以在山地生物群系 170Y 以上的高空较常见地发现它。它还会在采矿维度中 Y -59 到 Y 20 之间的任何位置生成，也会出现在异界维度的深板岩层洞穴中
